a:authorAction.a:name: How Humboldt wrote these letters
a:authorAction.a:description: Shows the selected letters (case kept) inside Humboldt's words, from five years either side of this document's date.

a:arguments.a:argument: concat('https://maelkolb.github.io/humboldt-hand-lookup/#q=', encode-for-uri(concat('"', normalize-space('${selection}'), '"')), '&case=1', string-join( for $date in (//*:correspAction[@type = 'sent']/*:date, //*:profileDesc/*:creation/*:date)[1], $from in substring(($date/@when, $date/@notBefore, $date/@from, $date/@notAfter, $date/@to)[1], 1, 4), $to in substring(($date/@when, $date/@notAfter, $date/@to, $date/@notBefore, $date/@from)[1], 1, 4) return if (number($from) = number($from) and number($to) = number($to)) then concat('&y=', number($from) - 5, '-', number($to) + 5) else '', ''))
